manifest_metadata.phase: Phase 1 - Evidence Reliability Audit and Benchmark Expansion Design
manifest_metadata.author_role: Senior RAG Research Engineer & Multilingual Evaluation Specialist

score_scale_incompatibility.description: EvidenceController evaluated retrieval scores with fixed min_score=0.35, but received raw RRF scores <= 0.033 in E10, triggering 100% false abstentions on answerable queries.

benchmark_sample_size_limitation.description: N=2 unanswerable instances provides zero degrees of freedom for threshold calibration or ROC/PR curve plotting.

citation_claim_support_limitation.description: claim_supported is currently hardcoded to True in generator.py if passage_id exists in retrieved pool, without verifying semantic text entailment.

score_normalizers.bm25: Dynamic pool-level min-max normalization with query term damping
score_normalizers.dense_faiss: Clamped cosine normalization to [0.0, 1.0] using empirical noise floor (0.20) and ceiling (0.80)
score_normalizers.hybrid_rrf: Theoretical maximum normalization: S_rrf / S_max where S_max = 2.0 / (k + 1)
score_normalizers.cross_encoder: Temperature-scaled logistic sigmoid: sigma((z - mu_prior) / tau) with tau=1.8

multi_feature_confidence_vector.phi_formulation: alpha_1 * s_1 + alpha_2 * delta_s12 + alpha_3 * c_consensus + alpha_4 * cov_intent + v_align

calibration_methodology_specification.cross_validation_strategy: Stratified 5-Fold Cross-Validation on expanded benchmark with zero test set leakage
